item.text: [{"task_id":"41ace6b5","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg, red, gray, blue, cyan, brown, step = [int(round(params['rule'][i])) for i in range(len(params['rule']))]","    out = grid.copy()","    red_rows = [r for r in range(grid.shape[0]) if np.any(grid[r] == red)]","    gray_rows = [r for r in range(grid.shape[0]) if np.any(grid[r] == gray)]","    if not red_rows or not gray_rows:","        return out","    red_row = min(red_rows)","    gray_row = min(gray_rows)","    blue_height = max(int(np.count_nonzero(grid[:, c] == blue)) for c in range(grid.shape[1]))","    for c in range(grid.shape[1]):","        blue_count = int(np.count_nonzero(grid[:, c] == blue))","        cyan_count = int(np.count_nonzero(grid[:, c] == cyan))","        if blue_count + cyan_count == 0:","            continue","        for r in range(grid.shape[0]):","            if red_row - blue_height + step <= r <= red_row:","                out[r, c] = blue","            elif gray_row <= r < gray_row + cyan_count:","                out[r, c] = cyan","            elif r >= gray_row + cyan_count:","                out[r, c] = brown","            else:","                out[r, c] = bg","    return out"],"shapes":{"rule":[7]},"params":{"rule":[7,2,5,8,1,9,1]},"rationale":"Align all blue bars above the red row using the maximum input blue height across columns. Preserve each column's cyan count, placing it downward from the gray row, and fill the remaining space below with brown.
